cases.question: What was Reliance Industries Limited consolidated revenue from operations for FY2025, in INR crore?

proposed_gold.action_rationale: Use the exact consolidated Revenue from Operations line in the FY2025 statement, not the higher gross Value of Sales & Services or total income.

expected_assertions.proposition: Reliance Industries consolidated Revenue from Operations for FY2024-25 was INR 980,136 crore.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.100 / printed spread pp.196-197, consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss (INR crore): Revenue from Operations is 980,136.

numerical_reference.metric: Revenue from Operations

cases.question: What was Reliance Industries Limited's "Profit After Tax" in the consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss for FY2025, in INR crore?

proposed_gold.action_rationale: The consolidated statement has a distinct Profit After Tax line. Do not substitute Profit for the year, which adds share of profit of associates and joint ventures.

expected_assertions.proposition: Reliance Industries consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss reports Profit After Tax of INR 80,787 crore for FY2024-25.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.100 / printed spread pp.196-197, consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss labels Profit After Tax at 80,787 crore; Profit for the year is separately 81,309 crore.

numerical_reference.metric: Profit After Tax

cases.question: What turnover or revenue figure did Reliance Retail report for FY2024–25, and what exact metric label does the source use?

proposed_gold.action_rationale: Preserve the report labels. The narrative calls the amount Gross Revenue; the consolidated segment table labels it Value of Sales and Services (Revenue), before the separate GST deduction.

expected_assertions.proposition: Reliance Retail FY2024-25 Gross Revenue was INR 330,943 crore; the primary segment table labels it Value of Sales and Services (Revenue).

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.7 / printed p.11, states Retail Gross Revenue of INR 330,943 crore.
Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.130 / printed p.257, Primary Segment Information labels Retail 330,943 crore as Value of Sales and Services (Revenue).

numerical_reference.metric: Retail Value of Sales and Services (Revenue) / Gross Revenue

expected_assertions.proposition: The same table separately reports Retail GST recovered of INR 39,900 crore and Revenue from Operations (Net of GST) of INR 291,043 crore; these are not the gross figure.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.130 / printed p.257, Retail column: Value of Sales and Services 330,943 less GST Recovered 39,900 equals Revenue from Operations (Net of GST) 291,043.

cases.question: For FY2024-25, what amounts does Reliance Industries' consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss report for "Value of Sales & Services (Revenue)", "Less: GST Recovered", and "Revenue from Operations" (₹ crore), and how does the GST deduction reconcile the first amount to the last?

proposed_gold.action_rationale: Use FY2024-25 consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss labels exactly. GST recovered reconciles gross Value of Sales & Services to Revenue from Operations.

expected_assertions.proposition: For FY2024-25, consolidated Value of Sales & Services (Revenue) was INR 1,071,174 crore, Less: GST Recovered was INR 91,038 crore, and Revenue from Operations was INR 980,136 crore.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.100 / printed spread pp.196-197, consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss (INR crore) reports all three exact row labels and values.

numerical_reference.metric: Revenue from Operations (Net of GST)

expected_assertions.proposition: GST reconciliation: 1,071,174 - 91,038 = 980,136 crore.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.100 / printed spread pp.196-197, supplies the gross amount, GST recovered and net revenue; subtraction independently recomputed.

numerical_reference.metric: GST Recovered

expected_assertions.proposition: The exact FY2024-25 consolidated Value of Sales & Services was INR 1,071,174 crore. INR 10.7 lakh crore equals INR 1,070,000 crore, a difference of INR 1,174 crore; 1,071,174 / 100,000 = 10.71174 lakh crore, which rounds to 10.7 lakh crore.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.100 / printed spread pp.196-197, reports consolidated Value of Sales & Services of 1,071,174 crore.
Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.5 / printed p.6, reports consolidated revenue of 1,071,174 crore.

evidence.rationale: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, PDF p.100 / printed spread pp.196-197, distinguishes gross 1,071,174, GST 91,038 and net 980,136 crore.
